parts.stem:
Soil fertility of different types of soil can be measured.

Put the method in order.

items.value: Measure the amount of humus to find out soil fertility.
Put equal samples of the different types of soil in three equal-sized cylinders so that each has only one type of soil.
Shake each cylinder to mix the soil and water thoroughly.
Add an equal amount of water to each cylinder.
Allow the mixture to settle into separate layers.

correct_answer: Put equal samples of the different types of soil in three equal-sized cylinders so that each has only one type of soil.
Add an equal amount of water to each cylinder.
Shake each cylinder to mix the soil and water thoroughly.
Allow the mixture to settle into separate layers.
Measure the amount of humus to find out soil fertility.
